d:
Discover the rich history and cultural significance of the Historic Qafila of Ramzan in Patna. This documentary takes you on a journey through time, exploring the traditions, rituals, and the profound community spirit that defines this unique Ramadan caravan. Join us as we uncover the stories behind the Qafila and its lasting impact on the city of Patna and beyond.
